荒漠砾坡上的黄色残遗小灌木 · A yellow-flowered relict shrub of stony deserts

砾坡一岁
From new shoots to winter cushion

春季萌发枝叶，夏季开黄色单花，随后形成蒴果；寒季保留贴地木质枝。
Shoots develop in spring, flowers open in summer and capsules follow; low woody branches persist through winter.

密集对生枝以短刺状顶端收束。
Dense branchlets end in a short spine.

Leathery leaves 5–7mm, revolute.

幼枝、叶和萼片密被白毛。
Shoots and sepals pale-pubescent.

矮小垫状灌木，高约5–12 cm；枝密而对生，常以刺状枝端收束。叶革质、边缘反卷并密被白色短柔毛；枝端单生黄色五瓣花。
A 5–12 cm cushion shrub with dense opposite, spine-tipped branches, tiny leathery revolute leaves and solitary yellow flowers.
IMPORTANT NOTE · 重 要 提 示
古地中海退却的生命遗存 · A Living Relic of the Retreating Tethys Sea

半日花是古地中海（特提斯海）沿岸植物区系退却后遗留下来的残遗种。在距今千万年的地质变迁与气候干旱化过程中，它顽强地在鄂尔多斯高原的荒漠环境中存活至今，对研究亚洲中部荒漠植被起源和古地理环境变迁具有不可估量的科学价值。\nHelianthemum songaricum is a relict species left behind by the retreat of the ancient Mediterranean (Tethys) flora. Over tens of millions of years of geological changes and climatic aridification, it has stubbornly survived in the desert environment of the Ordos Plateau. It holds immeasurable scientific value for studying the origin of desert vegetation in Central Asia and paleogeographic environmental changes.

鄂尔多斯半日花 H. ordosicum
花瓣倒卵形，鲜黄、干后淡粉红；萼片5条绿色纵肋；花期花梗直立。\nPetals obovate, bright yellow, turning pale pink when dry; sepals with 5 green ribs; pedicels erect during anthesis.

常见于海拔1000–1400m的石质山地、坡地和荒漠草原；在西鄂尔多斯可成为独特荒漠群落的建群种。\nCommon on rocky mountains, slopes, and desert steppes at altitudes of 1000–1400m; in western Ordos, it can become a constructive species of unique desert communities.

荒漠砾坡上的黄色残遗小灌木 · A yellow-flowered relict shrub of stony deserts

荒漠遗痕
Ancient survivor in the desert

春季萌发新叶，夏季开黄色小花，秋季结球形蒴果，冬季枝条枯黄呈垫状。 
 New leaves emerge in spring, small yellow flowers bloom in summer, spherical capsules form in autumn, and woody cushion-like branches persist in winter.
GLOBAL RANGE · 全 球 分 布
中国特有种，主要分布于内蒙古鄂尔多斯高原的荒漠地带 · Endemic to China, primarily distributed in the desert regions of the Ordos Plateau, Inner Mongolia.
FIELD IDENTIFICATION · 识 别 手 记
四个关键形态  diagnostic traits

植株低矮，呈垫状或半球形，枝条密集交错，形成独特的抗风沙结构。 
 Low-growing, forming cushion-like or hemispherical shrubs with densely interwoven branches, creating a unique wind and sand resistant structure.

叶片对生，肉质肥厚，倒卵形至匙形，表面光滑，具短柄，适应干旱环境。 
 Leaves are opposite, succulent and thick, obovate to spatulate, with a smooth surface and short petioles, adapted to arid environments.

花单生于叶腋，黄色，花瓣4枚，倒卵形，雄蕊8枚，花期夏季。 
 Flowers are solitary in leaf axils, yellow, with four obovate petals and eight stamens, blooming in summer.

果实为球形蒴果，直径约5-8毫米，成熟时沿4条缝线开裂，内含数粒种子。 
 Fruit is a spherical capsule, about 5-8 mm in diameter, splitting along four sutures when mature, containing several seeds.
四合木是蒺藜科四合木属的落叶小灌木，高20-50厘米。枝条密集，多分枝，老枝灰褐色，新枝黄绿色。叶对生，肉质，倒卵形至匙形，全缘。花单生于叶腋，黄色，花瓣4枚，倒卵形。果实为蒴果，球形，成熟时4瓣裂。

Tetraena mongolica is a deciduous shrub belonging to the Zygophyllaceae family, typically 20-50 cm tall. It has dense, multi-branched stems, with old branches being grayish-brown and new ones yellowish-green. Leaves are opposite, succulent, obovate to spatulate, with entire margins. Flowers are solitary in leaf axils, yellow, with four obovate petals. The fruit is a spherical capsule, splitting into four valves when mature.
IMPORTANT NOTE · 重 要 提 示
极度濒危的孑遗植物 · Critically Endangered Relict Plant

四合木是第三纪孑遗植物，被誉为“植物活化石”，其基因组测序研究揭示了其在极端干旱环境下独特的适应机制，包括高效的水分利用和抗氧化系统。由于其极度狭窄的分布区和脆弱的生境，已被列为国家一级重点保护野生植物，面临严重的灭绝风险。 
 *Tetraena mongolica* is a Tertiary relict plant, known as a "living fossil". Genomic sequencing studies have revealed its unique adaptation mechanisms to extreme arid environments, including efficient water utilization and antioxidant systems. Due to its extremely narrow distribution and fragile habitat, it has been listed as a national first-class protected wild plant, facing severe extinction risk.
SIMILAR SPECIES · 相 似 种
花瓣、萼片纵肋与花梗姿态  petals, sepal ribs & pedicel posture

霸王为落叶灌木，叶片为二回羽状复叶，小叶肉质，花黄色，但果实为倒卵形或近球形的翅果，而非四合木的球形蒴果。 
 *Zygophyllum xanthoxylum* is a deciduous shrub with bipinnate compound leaves, succulent leaflets, and yellow flowers, but its fruit is an obovoid or subglobose samara, not the spherical capsule of *Tetraena mongolica*.

白刺为落叶灌木，枝条常具刺，叶片肉质，条形或倒披针形，花白色或淡黄色，果实为红色浆果，与四合木的黄色花和蒴果明显不同。 
 *Nitraria tangutorum* is a deciduous shrub with spiny branches, succulent, linear or oblanceolate leaves, white or pale yellow flowers, and red berries, distinctly different from *Tetraena mongolica*'s yellow flowers and capsules.
TYPICAL HABITAT · 典 型 生 境
荒漠砾石坡与盐碱地 · Desert Gravel Slopes and Saline-Alkali Lands

四合木主要生长在荒漠、半荒漠地区的砾石坡、石质山坡、洪积扇边缘以及轻度盐渍化的沙地或粘土质土壤上。它对干旱、贫瘠和盐碱环境具有极强的适应性，常形成稀疏的灌丛或与其它旱生植物混生。
*Tetraena mongolica* primarily grows on gravel slopes, rocky hillsides, edges of alluvial fans, and slightly salinized sandy or clay soils in desert and semi-desert regions. It has extreme adaptability to drought, barrenness, and saline-alkali environments, often forming sparse scrubs or mixing with other xerophytic plants.

耐寒耐热 · Cold and heat tolerant

HUMANITIES · 植 物 人 文
珍稀的生态指示物种 · Rare Ecological Indicator Species

四合木作为中国特有的孑遗植物，是研究古地理、古气候和植物区系演化的重要材料。其独特的抗旱、抗盐碱特性使其在荒漠化防治和生态修复方面具有潜在价值。由于其极度濒危的现状，它也是生物多样性保护的旗舰物种之一，对维护荒漠生态系统的稳定性和完整性具有不可替代的生态学意义。
As an endemic relict plant of China, *Tetraena mongolica* is an important material for studying paleogeography, paleoclimate, and flora evolution. Its unique drought and salt-alkali resistance gives it potential value in desertification control and ecological restoration. Due to its critically endangered status, it is also a flagship species for biodiversity conservation, holding irreplaceable ecological significance for maintaining the stability and integrity of desert ecosystems.

蒙 古 沙 冬 青
荒漠中的常绿灌木，冬季不落叶 · An evergreen shrub in deserts, retaining leaves in winter

沙海绿洲
Evergreen oasis in the sand

蒙古沙冬青在春季萌发新叶，夏季开花，秋季结荚，冬季常绿。 
 Mongolian Ammopiptanthus sprouts new leaves in spring, flowers in summer, forms pods in autumn, and remains evergreen in winter.
GLOBAL RANGE · 全 球 分 布
主要分布于中国内蒙古、宁夏、甘肃等地的荒漠和半荒漠地区 · Primarily distributed in desert and semi-desert regions of Inner Mongolia, Ningxia, and Gansu, China.
FIELD IDENTIFICATION · 识 别 手 记
四个关键形态  diagnostic traits

叶片单生，革质，倒卵形至倒披针形，全缘，两面密被绒毛，冬季不脱落，是荒漠中罕见的常绿植物。 
 Leaves are simple, leathery, obovate to oblanceolate, entire, densely tomentose on both surfaces, and persist through winter, making it a rare evergreen in deserts.

花序为顶生或腋生总状花序，花冠黄色，具典型的蝶形花结构，旗瓣宽大，翼瓣和龙骨瓣较小。 
 Inflorescences are terminal or axillary racemes, with yellow corollas featuring typical papilionaceous structure, a broad standard petal, and smaller wing and keel petals.

果实为扁平的荚果，长椭圆形，表面密被灰白色绒毛，边缘增厚，成熟时不开裂，内含1-2粒种子。 
 The fruit is a flattened, oblong pod, densely covered with grayish-white tomentum, with thickened margins, indehiscent at maturity, containing 1-2 seeds.

植株通常呈垫状或半球形，枝条粗壮，幼枝密被绒毛，形成紧凑的灌木形态，适应荒漠风沙环境。 
 Plants typically form a cushion or hemispherical shape, with robust branches and densely tomentose young shoots, creating a compact shrub form adapted to desert wind and sand.
蒙古沙冬青是一种常绿灌木，高可达2米，通常呈垫状或半球形。其枝条粗壮，幼枝密被灰白色绒毛。叶片单生，革质，倒卵形至倒披针形，全缘，两面密被绒毛，冬季不脱落。花序为顶生或腋生总状花序，花冠黄色，蝶形。荚果扁平，密被绒毛，成熟时不开裂。

Ammopiptanthus mongolicus is an evergreen shrub, growing up to 2 meters tall, typically forming a cushion or hemispherical shape. Its branches are robust, with young shoots densely covered in grayish-white tomentum. Leaves are simple, leathery, obovate to oblanceolate, entire, densely tomentose on both surfaces, and persist through winter. Inflorescences are terminal or axillary racemes, with yellow, papilionaceous corollas. The fruit is a flattened pod, densely pubescent, and indehiscent at maturity.
IMPORTANT NOTE · 重 要 提 示
活化石与极端适应 · Living Fossil and Extreme Adaptation

蒙古沙冬青被誉为“活化石”，是第三纪残遗植物，其最显著的特征是在极度干旱寒冷的荒漠环境中保持常绿，这在落叶阔叶植物占主导的温带豆科植物中极为罕见，反映了其独特的生理适应机制。 
 Ammopiptanthus mongolicus is renowned as a "living fossil," a Tertiary relict species. Its most striking feature is its evergreen nature in extremely arid and cold desert environments, which is highly unusual among temperate deciduous legumes, reflecting its unique physiological adaptation mechanisms.
SIMILAR SPECIES · 相 似 种
花瓣、萼片纵肋与花梗姿态  petals, sepal ribs & pedicel posture

短柄沙冬青植株矮小，叶片较小且通常为倒卵形，花序更短，荚果被毛更密。 
 A. nanus is a smaller plant with smaller, typically obovate leaves, shorter inflorescences, and more densely hairy pods.

锦鸡儿属植物通常为落叶灌木，叶片为羽状复叶，且多数种类具有明显的刺，与蒙古沙冬青的常绿单叶形态差异显著。 
 Caragana species are typically deciduous shrubs with pinnately compound leaves, and most species have prominent thorns, differing significantly from the evergreen simple leaves of Ammopiptanthus mongolicus.
TYPICAL HABITAT · 典 型 生 境
荒漠砾石坡与沙地 · Desert Gravel Slopes and Sandy Areas

蒙古沙冬青主要生长在干旱、半干旱地区的砾石戈壁、固定或半固定沙丘、山前洪积扇以及干河床等生境中，偏爱排水良好、光照充足的沙质或砾质土壤。
*Ammopiptanthus mongolicus* primarily grows in habitats such as gravel deserts, fixed or semi-fixed sand dunes, piedmont alluvial fans, and dry riverbeds in arid and semi-arid regions, preferring well-drained, sun-exposed sandy or gravelly soils.
鄂托克 Otog, Ordos · 砾石戈壁 gravel Gobi
沙质/砾质土壤 · Sandy/gravelly soil
HUMANITIES · 植 物 人 文
重要的生态先锋与固沙植物 · Important Ecological Pioneer and Sand-Fixing Plant

蒙古沙冬青是荒漠生态系统中的关键物种，具有极强的抗旱、抗寒和耐贫瘠能力，是优良的固沙、防风、保持水土的先锋植物。其深根系有助于稳定沙丘，改善土壤结构。由于其独特的生态价值和作为第三纪残遗植物的科学意义，它在生态恢复和生物多样性保护中占有重要地位。
*Ammopiptanthus mongolicus* is a key species in desert ecosystems, possessing extremely strong drought, cold, and barrenness resistance. It is an excellent pioneer plant for sand fixation, windbreak, and soil and water conservation. Its deep root system helps stabilize sand dunes and improve soil structure. Due to its unique ecological value and scientific significance as a Tertiary relict plant, it plays an important role in ecological restoration and biodiversity conservation.

中国北方荒漠特有的孑遗小灌木 · A relict shrub endemic to the deserts of Northern China

戈壁刺甲
Thorny armor of the Gobi

春末夏初，绵刺枝头绽放黄白色小花，为荒漠增添一抹亮色。夏末秋初，其果实被白色棉毛包裹，随风滚动传播。 
 In late spring and early summer, small yellowish-white flowers bloom on Potaninia mongolica, adding a splash of color to the desert. In late summer and early autumn, its fruits, encased in white cottony hairs, are dispersed by wind.
GLOBAL RANGE · 全 球 分 布
中国内蒙古西部、宁夏、甘肃北部及蒙古国戈壁地区特有 · Endemic to western Inner Mongolia, Ningxia, northern Gansu in China, and the Gobi regions of Mongolia
FIELD IDENTIFICATION · 识 别 手 记
四个关键形态  diagnostic traits

矮小，呈垫状或半球形，枝条密生，老枝常具刺状短枝。 
 Dwarf, cushion-like or hemispherical, with densely arranged branches, older branches often developing into thorny short shoots.

叶片小，倒卵形至匙形，全缘，常3-5片簇生于短枝上。 
 Leaves small, obovate to spatulate, entire, often 3-5 fascicled on short shoots.

花小，黄白色，单生或数朵簇生于叶腋，花瓣5枚。 
 Flowers small, yellowish-white, solitary or several clustered in leaf axils, with 5 petals.

瘦果被宿存的、密被白色棉毛的萼片包裹，形似棉团，是其显著特征。 
 Achenes enclosed by a persistent, densely white-cottony calyx, resembling a cotton ball, a distinctive feature.
绵刺是一种矮小、多刺的落叶灌木，通常呈垫状或半球形，高可达50厘米。枝条密生，灰褐色，老枝常具刺状短枝。叶片小，倒卵形至匙形，全缘，常簇生于短枝上。花小，黄白色，单生或数朵簇生于叶腋。果实为瘦果，被宿存的、密被棉毛的萼片包裹，形似棉团。

Potaninia mongolica is a dwarf, thorny, deciduous shrub, typically forming cushion-like or hemispherical mounds up to 50 cm tall. Branches are densely arranged, grayish-brown, with older branches often developing into thorny short shoots. Leaves are small, obovate to spatulate, entire, and often fascicled on short shoots. Flowers are small, yellowish-white, solitary or clustered in leaf axils. The fruit is an achene, enclosed by a persistent, densely cottony calyx, resembling a cotton ball.
IMPORTANT NOTE · 重 要 提 示
孑遗物种与演化地位 · Relict Species and Evolutionary Status

绵刺是绵刺属中唯一的物种，被认为是适应极端干旱环境的孑遗植物。其独特的形态特征，特别是密被棉毛的宿存萼片包裹的果实，是其在多风的沙漠环境中进行种子传播的关键适应。最新的系统发育研究证实了其在蔷薇科中的独立演化地位，突显了其重要的进化意义和保护价值。 
 *Potaninia mongolica* is the sole species in the monotypic genus *Potaninia*, considered a relict plant adapted to extremely arid environments. Its unique morphological features, particularly the achenes enclosed by a densely cottony persistent calyx, are key adaptations for seed dispersal in windy desert conditions. Recent phylogenetic studies confirm its isolated evolutionary position within Rosaceae, highlighting its significant evolutionary importance and conservation value.
SIMILAR SPECIES · 相 似 种
花瓣、萼片纵肋与花梗姿态  petals, sepal ribs & pedicel posture

锦鸡儿属植物通常有羽状复叶和蝶形花，果实为荚果，与绵刺的单叶和棉毛状果实明显不同。
*Caragana* species typically have pinnate leaves and papilionaceous flowers, with pods as fruits, distinctly different from *Potaninia*'s simple leaves and cotton-like fruits.

沙棘的叶片为线形或披针形，花小不显，果实为橙黄色浆果状，无绵刺特有的棉毛状萼片。
*Hippophae rhamnoides* has linear or lanceolate leaves, inconspicuous small flowers, and orange-yellow berry-like fruits, lacking the cotton-like sepals typical of *Potaninia*.
TYPICAL HABITAT · 典 型 生 境
荒漠砾坡与沙地 · Desert Gravel Slopes and Sandy Areas

绵刺主要生长在干旱荒漠地区的砾石坡、沙砾地、固定或半固定沙丘边缘以及戈壁滩上。它对极端干旱、贫瘠的土壤和强烈的风蚀具有高度适应性，常与其他旱生灌木和草本植物混生，形成独特的荒漠植被群落。
*Potaninia mongolica* primarily grows on gravel slopes, sandy gravel lands, edges of fixed or semi-fixed sand dunes, and Gobi deserts in arid regions. It is highly adapted to extreme drought, barren soils, and strong wind erosion, often mixing with other xerophytic shrubs and herbs to form unique desert vegetation communities.

HUMANITIES · 植 物 人 文
生态价值与保护 · Ecological Value and Conservation
